name: ClaritX forward-tested AI stock-selection record
description: Pre-registered AI stock-selection strategies measured forward against a total-return S&P 500. Rules frozen before measurement; losing arms published.

files.title: Daily forward-test series, every registered strategy arm
files.description: One row per strategy-arm per trading day: the arm's index value and the total-return S&P 500 index over the same window, both rebased to 1.0 at that arm's registered inception. 925 observations, 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-25.

files.title: Strategy arms, registered rules and forward result
files.description: One row per registered strategy arm: inception, trading days elapsed, total return, S&P 500 over the same window, alpha, information ratio, Sharpe, annualised volatility and maximum drawdown. Losing arms are included — that is the point. Snapshot 2026-09-26.

files.title: Forward performance by AI score band
files.description: Every completed analysis scored 0-100 when published, then measured forward against a total-return S&P 500 over the same window, grouped into score bands. Snapshot 2026-09-26, 1,059 analyses.

files.title: Archived nightly cohort snapshots
files.description: The same cohort measurement re-run and archived every night: 50 dated snapshots from 2026-07-17 to 2026-09-26, 300 rows. Best and worst holding named in each.

citation: ClaritX Research Engine, "Forward-tested AI stock-selection record", snapshot 2026-09-26. https://www.claritx.ai/research
